added_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Applicable execution creates a bounded run with explicit Persona binding; unsupported capability fails closed.
added_requirements.requirement: TW Main shall launch bounded Subagent executions for applicable AAA Personas.

added_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Every material run references one versioned digestible reconstructable Persona Runtime Packet.
added_requirements.requirement: Every Subagent execution shall bind to an explicit Persona Runtime Packet.

added_requirements.acceptance_criteria: RUN_ID is never used as PERSONA_ID and the binding is explicit.
added_requirements.requirement: Persona identity and Subagent Run identity shall remain distinct.

added_requirements.acceptance_criteria: RUN_ID uniqueness and PERSONA_BINDING_REF are deterministically checkable.
added_requirements.requirement: Every material Subagent execution shall have a unique RUN_ID and explicit Persona binding.

added_requirements.acceptance_criteria: AUTHOR_AGENT_RUN_ID != VALIDATOR_AGENT_RUN_ID and separate run evidence exists.
added_requirements.requirement: Author and Validator shall execute as separate runs.

added_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Validator run binds a distinct INPUT_CONTEXT_DIGEST and validation context bundle.
added_requirements.requirement: Validator execution shall use a separately constructed validation context bundle.

added_requirements.acceptance_criteria: TARGET_WRITE_PERMISSION is FALSE unless a separately governed exception exists; same-act target modification plus PASS is prohibited.
added_requirements.requirement: Validator execution shall not have material target-write authority by default.

added_requirements.acceptance_criteria: EXACT_TARGET_REF and TARGET_SHA256 or canonical normative digest are present and recomputable.
added_requirements.requirement: Validation execution shall bind to an exact target identity and digest.

added_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Separate-thread/context, write permission, model-family, provider and independence class are explicitly recorded.
added_requirements.requirement: Execution independence properties shall be recorded as metadata and shall not be assumed.

added_requirements.acceptance_criteria: SAME_MODEL_FAMILY and SAME_PROVIDER are recorded truthfully and no stronger independence class is claimed.
added_requirements.requirement: Same-model or same-provider procedural validation may be used in the current experimental profile only when accurately disclosed.

added_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Unproven independence claim is rejected or marked NOT_PROVEN.
added_requirements.requirement: Model-family or provider independence shall not be claimed unless proven.

added_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Routine finding/correction routing does not require Owner transport unless a material Owner decision surface is encountered.
added_requirements.requirement: Validator findings shall route through TW Main to correction execution without routine Owner relay.

added_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Runtime packet normative fields contain no provider-specific authority semantics and can bind an alternate approved engine without Persona redesign.
added_requirements.requirement: Persona Runtime Packet semantics shall remain execution-engine independent.

added_requirements.acceptance_criteria: Material runs record RUN_ID, PERSONA_ID, input/output refs, target refs where applicable, result state and lineage.
added_requirements.requirement: TW shall preserve auditable Author, Validator, Correction and L2 run attribution.

merged_candidates.reason: Existing requirements already prohibit unvalidated intermediate external governed dependency and target zero unvalidated exports; subagent outputs are explicitly included by profile successor without changing the requirement semantics.
Existing exact-target successor and fresh-validation semantics already cover material correction.
Existing requirement already preserves Persona/Authority/Validation SoT outside replaceable external runners.
Existing deterministic-first requirement already separates calculable mechanics from LLM reasoning.
